input_provenance.command_template: $MINIC_NATIVE --backend=c -o OUT.c --emit-mir OUT.mir <91 sorted compiler Kotlin source paths> --stdlib <62 sorted stdlib Kotlin source paths>
input_provenance.invocation_backend: C emitter plus MIR serialization; no clang compile/link included

caveats: The integrated app API O3 outputs are byte-identical at the object-file level to earlier published 0.7 API O3 outputs; linked executable size differs slightly because package archives differ.

Fixed selfcompile inputs are the same clean 8ce0e5c source tree used for the initial compiler baseline, with all 153 relative input paths and SHA-256 values recorded. The integrated compiler produces the same C and MIR hashes as the original baseline.
Selfcompile wall-time ranges overlap. Instruction-count reduction is small (~1.4%) and does not constitute a substantial speedup.
No allocation counters were available. CPU target remains generic.

The published 0.7 package comparison above is observational, not causal, because packaged runtime/archive builds differ. The isolated_local_api_control compares local API O1 compiler binaries linked with the same candidate runtime objects and LLVM static link recipe.
Hello size direction: published package executable 54,280 bytes; integrated package executable 54,352 bytes. The object files are both 872 bytes and byte-identical.

binary_provenance.baseline_built_with: candidate compiler; --backend=llvm-api --opt=O1; clang final static link only
binary_provenance.shared_link_recipe: same LLVM 18 static libraries, system libraries, force-loaded zstd/libunwind, c++ runtime and export flags per compiler/bootstrap.sh
binary_provenance.compiler_codegen_optimization: LLVM API O1 (clang does not codegen the compiler binary)
binary_provenance.runtime_objects: candidate api/rt/*.o reused for both native compiler links; runtime object flags -O1
binary_provenance.link_flags: same LLVM 18 static libraries/system libraries, force-loaded static zstd/libunwind, C++ runtime, export-dynamic and -lm; see compiler/bootstrap.sh
